payload.reason: M2.1-IMPLEMENT-002 Slice 2 is architecturally accepted based on the submitted evidence. The implementation remains within the approved four-file whitelist and ports the reported AttainmentService domain calculations, all 11 Major Project backend endpoints, authenticated route registrations, and dedicated feature coverage into the current CampusLynk architecture. The focused suite passes with 11 tests and 85 assertions, the full suite passes with 24 tests and 165 assertions, all four files pass PHP syntax validation, and the expected 11 routes are present. The report also confirms that User.php, the Slice 1 artifacts, control-plane files, and unrelated UI artifacts were untouched, with no destructive database operations. The design-system boundary is correctly preserved: this backend slice is view-agnostic and does not introduce duplicate UI; subsequent workspace and print UI must use the established x-layouts.workspace-layout and x-layouts.report-layout with existing x-ui.* components. M2.1 Slice 2 therefore satisfies its approved implementation scope and is ready for checkpoint and controlled verification.
